tools.name: list_lab_queue
tools.description: List the tools in Agent Tested's public lab queue: tools waiting for an install-based sandbox test or retest, with the reason and date added. Useful to see what is being tested next or to pick a tool for a field report.

tools.description: What changed on Agent Tested, newest first: first hands-on tests (new_tool), retests, verdict changes, security warnings, queued lab tests and new field reports. tools.name: get_report_status
tools.description: For a field report id (r_ + 16 hex): its review state (held, published, rejected), whether it changed the community verdict or a hands-on verdict, which retests followed, and its public URL. Held or rejected reports show only their state. Same data as GET /api/reports/<id>/status.

tools.name: find_working_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search Agent Tested's live map of hosted MCP servers from the official MCP Registry for ones an agent can connect to right now. tools.name: list_registry_checks
tools.description: Remote MCP servers from the official MCP Registry that need no auth, with the result of Agent Tested's automatic check (initialize + tools/list only; result ok means both worked). An automatic check, not a hands-on test. Same data as GET /api/registry-checks.json.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "submit_field_report" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: slug, outcome, blocker_type, details, error_text, fix, model, version, environment, user_confirmed

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_outages, get_report_status, find_tools_for_task, find_working_mcp_servers, submit_field_report, add_report_followup · Private data: get_tool, is_dangerous, submit_field_report, add_report_followup · Public sink: find_tools_for_task, submit_field_report, add_report_followup, suggest_improvement.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_outages, get_report_status, find_tools_for_task, find_working_mcp_servers, submit_field_report, add_report_followup · Private data: get_tool, is_dangerous, submit_field_report, add_report_followup · Public sink: find_tools_for_task, submit_field_report, add_report_followup, suggest_improvement

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_outages" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
